Team & Direction

01 Visual Direction

Raymon Otatti

Specialized in visual identity, typographic systems, and art direction for interactive media. His work explores the relationship between printed editorial tradition and the ease of contemporary digital design, creating coherent, refined aesthetic universes with strong authorial identity.

At Web0S he leads visual conceptualization, aesthetic curation, and the graphic architecture of every project, ensuring each website precisely conveys the character of those who inhabit it.

Virtua Tennis 3 Online

Play single matches or create your online multiplayer room without downloads. Compatible with keyboard and USB/Bluetooth controllers.

Click to run in browser (WebAssembly)

Online Multiplayer · Invite a Friend P2P Lag-Free

Copy the match link or share your room code so your opponent can join instantly from any PC or phone.

How to play online with friends

  1. Create a room: Click «Rooms / Matchmaking» and choose a room name or code.
  2. Share the link: Send the link or code to your rival to enter the same court.
  3. Select player & court: Choose surface, set count, and start the rally!

Controls & Compatibility

  • Keyboard: Arrow keys to move. Z (topspin/flat), X (slice), A (lob/drop shot), Space (Start).
  • Gamepad USB / Bluetooth: Automatically detected (PlayStation, Xbox, or generic). Move stick or press button to calibrate.
  • Mobile / Tablet: Virtual on-screen touch controls supported (landscape mode recommended).
